quotes.text: Cliff Richard is a footnote to a more important historical event
They were imitators, so why bother?
Cliff Richard and the Shadows had enormous influence in the UK, serving as a beacon of hope to budding musicians that Englishmen could make it big in the world of rock 'n' roll.
it's impossible to omit Cliff and the Shadows from any serious discussion of the development of British popular music.
it was not until his 1976 album I'm Nearly Famous that Richard changed the focus of his recording career from singles to albums
In 2023, marking his 65th anniversary, he released the album Cliff with Strings: My Kinda Life, a reworking of his classic hits reimagined in an orchestral arrangement.
Richard was originally marketed as a rebellious rock and roll singer in the style of Presley and Little Richard.
With his backing group, the Shadows, he dominated the British popular music scene in the pre-Beatles period of the late 1950s to early 1960s.
His 1958 hit single "Move It" is often described as Britain's first authentic rock and roll song.
Increased focus on his Christian faith and subsequent softening of his music led to a more middle-of-the-road image, and he sometimes ventured into contemporary Christian music.
